results.title: LLM-infused multi-module transformer for emotion-aware ...
results.content: Volume 126, Part B, February 2026, 103668. # Full length article LLM-infused multi-module transformer for emotion-aware sentiment analysis in few-shot scenarios. CogTrans integrates emotion-cognition with transformer-based sentiment models. LLM-driven data augmentation improves few-shot sentiment classification. Mask-transformer module extracts high-quality semantic representations. Crisis-aware intent prediction supports analysis of urgent public discourse. Sentiment analysis, particularly in few-shot scenarios and under constraints of limited data availability, presents significant challenges in accurately capturing the nuanced emotions conveyed in online reviews and public opinions. The Quantity Augmentation Module utilizes large language models (LLMs) to generate synthetic data, thereby improving learning efficiency in few-shot settings. The Emotional Cognitive Analysis (ECA) Module constructs a sentence–emotion tree to facilitate a deeper understanding of sentiment contexts. The Transformer-based Semantic Representation (T-SR) Module employs a mask-transformer architecture to extract high-quality semantic features. Its ability to provide well-contextualized sentiment predictions while incorporating emotional context, cognitive reasoning, and crisis-relevant insights makes it a highly promising tool for practical applications in crisis management and review analysis.
